advertisementContent.projectSpecificDetails: Many residents already call Cantilever House home and enjoy the comfort and convenience of this vibrant community. Now, just three beautifully designed one-bedroom units remain available at 21 Garden Street, located at the crossroads of Williamsburg and Bushwick. Each home features an open layout with a charming kitchen and bathroom, offering an inviting place to live. Residents enjoy a full-service package room*, lounge with co-working and media spaces, and a state-of-the-art fitness center* with dedicated areas for yoga*, cardio*, and more. The landscaped rooftop deck* provides a relaxing outdoor space, while bike storage* and indoor parking* offer added convenience. With modern amenities, thoughtful design, and a prime Brooklyn location, Cantilever House offers comfortable urban living in a neighborhood full of energy and character. Pet-friendly (max 2, 30 lbs. each, non-aggressive breeds). Tenants are responsible for electricity, including electric stove, hot water, and heat.
advertisementContent.affordableHousingProgram: This building is being constructed through the Inclusionary Housing Program and is anticipated to receive a Tax Exemption through the 421a Tax Incentive program of the New York City Department of Housing Preservation and Development.
